#: Wording of the checks in test_busy_live.py. Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the check: keep them spelled exactly. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored.
live.alreadyBusy: something is already running, the check would not be trustworthy: %(busy)s
live.closingViaBridge: closing the program through the same bridge
live.exitButtonAppeared: the exit button was waited for
live.noApplyIsNotAChange: without apply it does not count as a change
live.noExitButton: no exit button was found, the windows were closed instead
live.sentCloseToWindows: the program did not close by itself, close was sent to its windows
live.setTestApp: set MO2AIBRIDGE_TEST_APP to the name of a tool from MO2 own list
live.title: the busy lock on a running program (%(app)s)
